column1: # macacfs tool catalog — the single source of truth for install/update.
# Columns (tab-separated): abbr  repo  cli  method  ref  args
#   installer-sh -> curl the repo's own installer | bash  (ref = path in repo, args = flags)
#   cargo-git    -> cargo install --git <ref> --force     (ref = repo git URL, args = extra flags e.g. --bin X)
#   go           -> go install <ref>                       (ref = module path incl @latest)
# repo is under https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/<repo>. Installer URLs use raw main.
# Brew-preferred where dicklesworthstone/tap publishes a formula (15 tools).
